title: The energy cost of intelligence: How AI is reshaping global power demand
description: AI training models and workloads are reshaping global energy consumption, with data centers vying for electricity alongside cities and hyperscalers making direct deals with grid operators. As affordable, green, local power emerges as a competitive advantage, India's distinct opportunity is to leverage the data centre expansion alongside its solar power capabilities.

title: Age of AI teammates: Redefining productivity and workplace collaboration
description: From finance to HR, AI agents are quietly automating decision layers once handled by humans. As agentic AI evolves from task executors to autonomous collaborators, it is reshaping workplace hierarchies, creativity, and accountability. Are we ready to treat algorithms as co-workers, not just tools?

title: Data-driven deeptech vs privacy rights: Startup strategies in India’s new regulatory era
description: As India’s data & technology laws evolve, startups face a defining challenge -- balancing deep tech innovation with the growing weight of privacy rights, AI, policy & regulations. Drawing from her regulatory expertise, Shivaarti Bajaj Founder of RSD Bajaj Global Law Firm, decodes how founders can stay compliant without slowing down breakthrough innovation.

speaker.name: Shivaarti Bajaj
speaker.designation: Founder & Managing Partner, RSD Bajaj Global

title: Intelligent enterprises: Designing human-centric growth in the age of AI
description: Today, every interaction sits at the intersection of creativity, data, and automation. But how are modern CMOs balancing technology and the "human" aspect of marketing? Learn the art and science of building connected brand ecosystems in today's intelligence-led world, reshaping the way enterprises connect, convert, and grow.

speaker.name: Jollydeep Kaur
speaker.designation: Head of Marketing, NextGen Cloud Technologies

title: CheQ Wisor — India’s first AI credit card expert
description: Built on the belief that credit shouldn’t be complicated. CheQ has helped millions pay, track and earn smarter on their credit card bills.

title: Decoding PolicyBazaar’s tech stack: Rewiring insurance with AI and automation
description: Insurance is no longer just distribution — it’s a real-time underwriting, personalisation and servicing engine powered by data and AI. At PolicyBazaar, advanced machine learning, behavioural analytics, and digital verification systems turn millions of customer signals into smarter product matching, personalised pricing insights, fraud reduction, and instant policy issuance. This conversation will dive into how the company’s technology foundation — spanning conversational AI, risk-assessment models, and digital claims workflows — is transforming insurance from paperwork-laden to predictive, proactive, and seamlessly digital for millions of Indians.

title: India's AI future: Building beyond Ohio's shadow
description: Every Indian developer who learned cloud computing knows Ohio—the AWS default. But as India builds its AI future, will the next generation still deploy there or in Bangalore? Vishnu Subramaniam of E2E Networks reveals what’s possible when India powers AI on its own terms.

speaker.name: Vishnu Subramanian
speaker.designation: Head of Product and Marketing, E2E Networks Limited

title: Human-Centered AI: Oversight without bottlenecks in autonomous industry
description: Autonomous industrial operations promise efficiency gains but raise critical questions: Who's accountable when AI decides?
